items.title: Mike Evans: DNP on Wednesday, may practice Thursday
items.text:
Head coach Kyle Shanahan said Evans (Achilles) won't practice Wednesday but hopes the wide receiver will return to drills Thursday, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Baker Mayfield: Week 11 status TBD
items.text:
Coach Todd Bowles said Wednesday that Mayfield (foot), who didn't practice Wednesday, is "a lot better" than he was a week ago, Scott Smith of the Buccaneers' official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Kenneth Walker: Set to log 'DNP' on Wednesday
items.text:
Walker (groin) won't practice Wednesday, Sam McDowell of The Kansas City Star reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Brandon Aiyuk: Deemed 100 percent ahead of likely release
items.text:
Aiyuk's agent, Drew Rosenhaus, said Tuesday that the receiver is "100 percent healthy" and fully recovered from his November 2024 right knee surgery and plans to work out for interested teams once he's released by the 49ers, Dianna Russini of BetUS TV reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Dontayvion Wicks: Could be back this week
items.text:
Coach Nick Sirianni relayed Wednesday that he feels good about the chances of Wicks (ankle) returning to action Sunday against the Steelers, Jeff McLane of The Philadelphia Inquirer reports.
